items.title: News: CMN Weekly (23 October 2026) - Your Weekly CRISPR Medicine News - CRISPR Medicine
key: A single infusion of Papillon Therapeutics’ CRISPR-Cas9 therapy PPL-001 edited haematopoietic stem and progenitor cells has corrected multisystemic disease in a humanised mouse model of Friedreich’s ataxia.
Excising the GAA expansion from FXN intron 1 raised frataxin levels, eased mitochondrial stress and inflammation, and preserved cerebellar architecture, cardiac tissue and pancreatic β cells.
